svg.title: EH3D-PHOENIX-LASER architecture
svg.desc: EH3D-PHOENIX-LASER is a Rust library and command line that turn an image into dots by dithering and write the G-code of a laser that burns line by line with dynamic power, and that read SVG and DXF drawings and write the G-code that cuts their contours and engraves their shapes, layer by layer, with the settings of each layer in a file. Built with the gui feature it also has a window (egui) that opens a picture or a drawing, shows the path of the laser, sets the power and the feed and exports the G-code.
